teaser: A notebook open to a blank page, pen capped, three doodles in the margin. Life path 3 asks you to fill a page with something that moves people; INTP wants the page to be right before it's loud. You're a 3 who thinks before speaking, a storyteller who checks the story's wiring twice before telling it to anyone. The charm this number calls for can stall behind a sentence still being revised in your head. What comes out, when it finally comes out, tends to be precise rather than performed — the joke built like an argument, the toast that lands because it was tested first.
